about.title: About me
about.bio: I'm an independent consultant specializing in TypeScript, React, and Node.js ecosystems. After over a decade of building production systems — from startups to enterprise — I now focus on helping teams navigate complex technical decisions. I bring deep expertise in frontend architecture, performance optimization, and modern JavaScript tooling. My approach is pragmatic: I help you choose the right tools, avoid over-engineering, and deliver value faster.

playground.title: Mage workshop
playground.intro: Enter a lightweight 2D game. Move stone blocks with telekinesis, build your own shape, and preserve it with frost in this browser.
playground.active: Controls active. Escape returns control to the page.
playground.telekinesisHint: Select and drag a block. Use the arrow keys on a keyboard.
playground.frostHint: Saves the blocks placed inside the sculpture area.
playground.lavaHint: Melts the saved sculpture and creates a new set of blocks.
playground.keyboardHelp: Mage: WASD or arrows when the scene is focused. Block: Tab, Enter, and arrows. Escape ends game control.
playground.localOnly: The sculpture is stored only in this browser and is never sent to a server.
playground.ready: The workshop is ready. Move blocks into the marked area.
playground.loaded: Your frozen sculpture is back. A new set of blocks waits beside it.
playground.selected: Block selected. Drag it or use the arrow keys.
playground.emptyFreeze: Place at least one block inside the sculpture area first.
playground.frozen: The frost spell worked. Your sculpture will survive your next visit.
playground.frozenMemory: The sculpture is frozen for this session only — the browser refused storage access.
playground.existing: One sculpture is already frozen. Melt it with lava before saving another.
playground.melted: Lava melted the sculpture. A new set of blocks appeared.
playground.refreshed: A new set of loose blocks has been generated.
playground.storageError: The local save could not be changed. Your sculpture remains untouched.
playground.invalidStorage: An unreadable or newer save was found. You can remove it with the lava spell.
playground.confirmDescription: Lava removes only the workshop save. This action cannot be undone.
